meta.title: Collage: sample draft
meta.description: Inspect a Word document imported as a draft with editable headings and a table.
meta.author: adamziel

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user(1);
$preview = new WP_REST_Request('POST');
$preview->set_param('sample', 'docx');
$result = PandocImporter\Plugin::convert($preview);
if (is_wp_error($result)) {
    throw new RuntimeException($result->get_error_message());
}
$draft = new WP_REST_Request('POST');
$draft->set_param('token', $result['token']);
$draft->set_param('title', 'A good place to start');
$result = PandocImporter\Plugin::draft($draft);
if (is_wp_error($result) || get_post_status($result['id']) !== 'draft') {
    throw new RuntimeException('The sample draft could not be created.');
}
